# Sweep
![](/images/sweep.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px" fig-align="center"}

Sweep buttons allow you to sweep away items you no longer want in RStudio. There are two main sweep buttons, one for the __Console window__ and one for the __Environment pane__.

## Console sweep

The sweep button for the __console window__ will clear all the text in the __console pane__. 
This is useful if you have filled the __console__ with lots of commands and <u id='data_frame_tooltip'>__data frames__</u>. 
This sweep button will not actually affect any of your work so do not be afraid to use it. 
The location of the sweep button is shown below.

![](/images/RStudio_console_sweep.png){style="width:600px; border-radius:5px" fig-align="center"}

## Environment sweep

The sweep button for the __Environment pane__ is a bit more dangerous. 
This sweep button will clear all the objects from your environment. 
This will remove all the <u id='variable_tooltip'>__variables__</u> you have created. 
This is not too bad if you have been using the __script editor__ to do your work as you can rerun all your commands to refill your environment. 
The location of the sweep button is shown below.

<center>
![](/images/RStudio_env_sweep.png){style="width:500px; border-radius:5px"}
</center>
